name: Liliana Pinnata
source:
"Liliana Pinnata. Nice to meet you--or maybe it's just been a while? I'm a follower of Aphesis. I perform exorcisms. You demons who twist people's fates... I will never forgive you. That includes you, Mai..."

A candidate for leadership within Aphesis. A devout and capable believer who fully understands the teachings of the cult.

She relentlessly pursues [url=/c160574]Mai[/url] for a certain reason. The reason would shock most people, but Mai seems to know exactly why...

She learned the truth of the world from the cult's founder, and through her mastery of the Code, she can perform feats akin to miracles. She seems unrelated to game development. I wonder how her path will cross with [url=/c160572]Sayaka's[/url].

Following Mai, she travels to Sagami City, where our story takes place. With the entire world on the brink, will she be able to hold onto her beliefs?

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category4&ch=liliana]official website[/url]]
